name: jira_get_field_options
description:
Get allowed option values for a custom field.

Returns the list of valid options for select, multi-select, radio,
checkbox, and cascading select custom fields.

Cloud: Uses the Field Context Option API. If context_id is not provided,
automatically resolves to the global context.

Server/DC: Uses createmeta to get allowedValues. Requires project_key
and issue_type parameters.

contains.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on option values. Also matches child values in cascading selects.

context_id.description: Field context ID (Cloud only). If omitted, auto-resolves to the global context.

field_id.description: Custom field ID (e.g., 'customfield_10001'). Use jira_search_fields to find field IDs.

issue_type.description: Issue type name (required for Server/DC). Example: 'Bug'

return_limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (applied after filtering).

values_only.description: If true, return only value strings in a compact JSON format instead of full option objects.
